LanguageData.MDWC_SettingsUnavailable: These settings are unavailable. Another mod has changed the medic warcasket's definitions, so the set keeps its built-in values.
LanguageData.MDWC_DosesDesc: The number of doses of each medicine type the armor's suite holds when full. A suite already holding more than this loses the excess. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_CastTimeDesc: How long the pilot takes to apply a field dressing. The patient is held still until it is done. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_CooldownDesc: The time the pilot must wait after a field dressing before applying another. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_RangeDesc: How close the pilot walks to the patient before applying the dressing. Within this range, a clear line of sight is enough. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_DressingSummary: The suite holds up to {0} of each medicine type. Each dressing takes {1} s to apply, then {2} s of cooldown before the next.
